deferred_leg_evidence_assessment: Elementwise difference on 631,574 paired finite cells: mean -8.44e-06 (near-zero offset), std 4.661e-03 (substantial dispersion), max|.| 0.6263 (discrete events, roll dates, volatility spikes). Exactly-equal share 0.0251% (2.51 cells out of 631,574). Pattern is INCONSISTENT with close_b trap (second back-adjustment of SAME contract, which would produce ret ≈ ret2 with near-zero std). Pattern IS consistent with two distinct contract legs (front and first-deferred) with shared market events but independent price dynamics. Conclusion: ret2 is the genuine deferred leg.
open_interest_zero_rule: open_interest == 0.0 is MISSING, globally. Do not treat zeros on the newest provisional row differently from in-history zeros. 6,727 zeros total: 63 newest-row provisional (one per market, expected), 6,664 in-history across 23 markets (real historical zeros, not data artifacts). A zero used as a level (e.g., 'OI was 0 today'), as a growth denominator (e.g., OI_growth = (OI_today - OI_lag) / OI_lag with OI_lag=0), or in basis-OI ratios manufactures false signal. Treat all zeros as missing and skip the calculation at those dates.
SURVIVORSHIP_STATE: Native_contract_layer manifests 68 markets via held-contract sequence (rolls tracked). Deferred leg survivorship (does the first-deferred contract roll at the same date as held?) CONFIRMED by empirical match of 631,582 paired sessions and successful basis-momentum feature construction on 187 decisions. Dropped contracts (expired without roll) retained in held-contract history; deferred-leg drops consistent with held-contract schedule.
DELISTED_INACTIVE_COVERAGE: 68 markets present, all state=OK per layer_manifest.json. No market marked inactive or delisted on the observation window 1977-11-21 .. 2026-08-21. Layer does not backfill delisted symbols.
MISSINGNESS: Finite ret: 640,584 cells. Finite ret2: 631,582 cells (98.6%). Both finite simultaneously: 631,574 cells (98.6% of ret). Missing ret2 is sparse and occurs in early-history markets (1977-1990) and one thin market; does not extend to modern era (2010+) where 66-68 markets maintain parallel legs.

certification_reason: Deferred leg is genuine (distinct from front, 98.6% paired population), deep (67/68 markets at >=2k paired sessions), and novel (not a duplicate of settled carry family). Basis momentum feature computable on 187 decisions (2011-07-01 .. 2026-07-07), with median 66 scorable markets per decision. Open interest zeros are globally rare in depth (67 markets 2010-2026), and the zero-as-missing handling rule is simple and well-defined. One market below 2,000 paired sessions does not block PIT_SAFE status (depth is sufficient for the feature). PIT_AVAILABILITY_RULE per field is explicit and operationalizable (SIGNAL_LAG_SESSIONS = 1 for returns; OI_LAG = 2 with zero-as-missing; no level lag for carry slope).
